works.title: The Qur'an
works.rightsNote: Cited by verse reference. The Arabic text displayed in the app comes verbatim from the raw layer (Tanzil Project).

works.title: The ruku divisions of the mushaf
works.rightsNote: The traditional division of each surah into rukus, the passages marked with ‘ع’ in the margins of South Asian mushafs. Taken from the Tanzil Project's Qur'an metadata (the raw layer) and checked against it automatically.

works.title: Tafsir Ibn Kathir
works.author: Isma'il ibn Kathir
works.description: Explains the Qur'an through the Qur'an itself, hadith and the sayings of the early generations.
works.rightsNote: Fourteenth-century Arabic text, in the public domain. Excerpts are quoted from the Arabic original, never from a modern (copyrighted) translation.

works.title: Tafsir al-Tabari
works.titleOriginal: جامع البيان عن تأويل آي القرآن
works.author: Muhammad ibn Jarir al-Tabari
works.description: One of the earliest and fullest tafsirs: collects the explanations of the Companions and their students, then weighs them.
works.rightsNote: Tenth-century Arabic text, in the public domain. Excerpts are quoted from the Arabic original.

works.title: Tafsir al-Qurtubi
works.author: Abu 'Abdullah al-Qurtubi
works.description: Known especially for drawing out the legal rulings in each passage.
works.rightsNote: Thirteenth-century Arabic text, in the public domain. Excerpts are quoted from the Arabic original.

works.title: Tafsir al-Sa'di
works.titleOriginal: تيسير الكريم الرحمن في تفسير كلام المنان
works.author: 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Nasir al-Sa'di
works.description: A concise modern classic, focused on the meaning and guidance of each passage.
works.rightsNote: The author died in 1956. That makes the text public domain in some countries (e.g. Saudi Arabia, India) but not yet in others, so it is treated as copyrighted: cited and summarized in our own words, never excerpted.

works.title: Tafheem-ul-Qur'an (Towards Understanding the Qur'an)
works.author: Sayyid Abul A'la Maududi
works.description: Written for modern readers: the setting of each surah, its message, and what it asks of us today.
works.rightsNote: English translation by Zafar Ishaq Ansari, published by the Islamic Foundation (UK). Cited and summarized only; written permission is needed before quoting it in a public launch.
works.accessedVia: islamicstudies.info (published there with permission of the Islamic Foundation UK)

works.title: Ma'arif al-Qur'an
works.author: Mufti Muhammad Shafi
works.description: A detailed commentary written in Urdu for general readers, drawing on classical tafsir and Hanafi scholarship.
works.rightsNote: English translation by Muhammad Hasan Askari and Muhammad Shamim (Maktaba-e-Darul-Uloom, Karachi). Cited and summarized only.

works.title: Sahih Muslim
works.author: Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj
works.rightsNote: Classical hadith collection. Numbering follows Muhammad Fu'ad 'Abd al-Baqi.

works.title: Sahih al-Bukhari
works.author: Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Bukhari
works.rightsNote: Classical hadith collection. Numbering follows the widely used Fath al-Bari numbering.

works.title: Jami' al-Tirmidhi
works.author: Abu 'Isa al-Tirmidhi
works.rightsNote: Classical hadith collection. Cited here as quoted, with al-Tirmidhi's own grading, by Ibn Kathir.
